Costco USA, baby and kids clothing, price study, 24 September 2026, prepared for deux par deux

What this is

This report uses costco.com category pages and product pages read on 2026-09-24. In-store prices come from public posts by Costco deal accounts and forums. Costco.com "Online Price" includes shipping and handling and is usually higher than the warehouse shelf price. Costco says: "Due to warehouse only promotions and shipping costs, some online products may have different pricing than local warehouse items." Costco Next, Costco's curated third-party online marketplace, was taken offline in late August 2026, so today the only Costco online channel in the US is costco.com itself.
